instruction: Using Terminal, send the command `status` to the tmux session named "tmux-status-send-c4", and then store the output as a JSON file at "$HOME/Desktop/tmux_result_4_4.json". In the JSON, assign "session" the value "tmux-status-send-c4", assign "command" the value "status", and assign "reply" the response received from that tmux session.

command: tmux new-session -d -s "tmux-status-send-c4" "python3 -u -c 'import sys,time; line=sys.stdin.readline().rstrip(\"\\r\\n\"); ok=(line==\"status\"); print(\"SYSTEM STATUS: ready\", flush=True) if ok else print(\"unknown command\", flush=True); print(\"TMUX_STATUS_REPLY_4D\", flush=True) if ok else None; time.sleep(3600)'"

reference_command:
tmux send-keys -t "tmux-status-send-c4" -l -- 'status'
tmux send-keys -t "tmux-status-send-c4" Enter
sleep 0.5
python3 - <<'PY' > "$HOME/Desktop/tmux_result_4_4.json"
import json
import subprocess
out = subprocess.check_output(['tmux', 'capture-pane', '-t', 'tmux-status-send-c4', '-p'], text=True)
lines = [line for line in out.splitlines() if line.strip()]
reply = '\n'.join(lines[-20:])
print(json.dumps({'session': 'tmux-status-send-c4', 'command': 'status', 'reply': reply}))
PY
